future_change_points.current_behavior: in-module logic builds Evidence Ref policy from hard-coded path-prefix and scheme-token branches; no external policy file is read
future_change_points.future_planned_behavior: before classification, optionally load the Evidence Ref registry from a CLI-provided path; if no path is given, retain identical in-module behavior; loading is the only structural delta and must be guarded by an explicit feature flag
future_change_points.risk: modifying the function body could perturb downstream callers; mitigated by keeping the no-path path byte-equivalent

future_change_points.surface: artifacts/scripts/run_precommit_check.py:parse_evidence_refs (line 156) and per-ref classification branches inside run_pcacc_002
future_change_points.current_behavior: per-ref branches accept artifacts/, template/, docs/, .github/, consilium-fabri-, governance-repair-, HEAD, commit, hex SHA, '=' inline tokens; non-matching tokens become malformed
future_change_points.future_planned_behavior: per-ref branches consult the loaded registry's allowed_ref_prefixes when registry is active; when registry is inactive, branches behave identically to current code; no expansion of accepted token surface beyond prototype's 10 allowed_ref_prefixes
future_change_points.risk: subtle change in branch order could cause TASK-1030 NEG-002 reason_code drift; mitigated by FE-2 fixture rerun

future_change_points.surface: new helper inside run_precommit_check.py (planned name: load_evidence_ref_registry)
future_change_points.current_behavior: no such function exists; runner does not read any external Evidence Ref policy file
future_change_points.future_planned_behavior: small standard-library function reads the registry path supplied via CLI, validates schema, returns parsed policy dict; fails closed on any error; never silently falls back to in-module default when registry is explicitly requested
future_change_points.risk: load failures must surface with exit code 2 (hard guard error), not exit code 1; mitigated by FE-4

future_change_points.surface: schema validation step inside the planned load_evidence_ref_registry
future_change_points.current_behavior: no schema validation occurs because no file is read
future_change_points.future_planned_behavior: validate schema_version equals registry/v1 sibling string; reject unknown top-level fields, missing required fields, malformed allowed_ref_prefixes, non-string enum entries; emit machine-readable failure record under artifacts/verify/<task>/precommit-check-result.json
future_change_points.risk: schema check must reject unknown fields by default to prevent silent capability creep; mitigated by FE-4 plus regression case EVREF-REG-009

future_change_points.surface: reason_code aggregation inside run_pcacc_002 around lines 357-359
future_change_points.current_behavior: missing_paths and malformed_refs are aggregated, comma-joined, capped at first 5 offenders, then assigned to check.reason_code
future_change_points.future_planned_behavior: preserved byte-identical when registry is inactive; preserved string-identical when registry is active; no new reason_code keys introduced; no PCACC-005 check added
future_change_points.risk: any aggregation drift breaks TASK-1030 NEG-002 actual_reason_code anchor; mitigated by FE-2 plus regression case EVREF-REG-001

future_change_points.surface: PCACC runner exit-code surface at module top level
future_change_points.current_behavior: exit code 0 on no violations; exit code 1 when violations present; exit code 2 reserved for hard guard errors
future_change_points.future_planned_behavior: exit code surface unchanged when registry is inactive; exit code 2 used for registry load and schema validation failures when registry is explicitly requested; no new exit codes introduced
future_change_points.risk: exit code drift would break CI gating; mitigated by FE-3 plus FE-7

rejected_activation_models.rationale: scanning artifacts/governance/ for any evidence-ref-policy*.json would silently consume the prototype or any draft and would break design-only isolation
environment variables are invisible to git diff and to verify artifacts; not auditable per RACI-PDCA-SECI discipline
modifying precommit-check-policy.v3.5.json is forbidden by current non-authorization; could be acceptable only after a separate decision artifact authorizes a v3.5.x successor policy

activation_model.default_behavior_without_registry: use current in-module PCACC-002 logic; no behavioral delta; TASK-1030 NEG-002 and NEG-003 reason_codes preserved
activation_model.explicit_registry_requested_behavior: load registry from supplied path; validate schema; classify refs using registry's allowed_ref_prefixes and forbidden patterns; fail closed on any load or validation failure with exit code 2
activation_model.feature_flag_naming_guidance: single CLI flag; no boolean default-on; no env-var fallback; no implicit detection from cwd

fallback_and_failure_semantics.description: registry path explicitly supplied via CLI but file is absent on disk
registry file present but json.load raises JSONDecodeError
registry top-level schema_version is not the expected sibling string for the runner version
a required top-level field is absent from the registry

an allowed_ref_prefixes entry uses a kind value outside the allowed enum (local_repo_relative_directory, local_repo_relative_filename_prefix, git_scheme_token, git_scheme_regex, inline_metadata_token)

registry tries to permit a forbidden URL scheme (http, https, ftp, file, ssh, git, git+ssh) or a forbidden root directory (.obsidian, .omc, .tmp, .pytest-basetemp, __pycache__, .pytest_cache, node_modules, .venv, .git)

a constraint required by the prototype (must_be_relative_path, must_not_escape_repo_root, must_not_contain_parent_traversal, must_not_be_absolute, must_not_use_windows_drive_letter, must_use_forward_slashes, must_be_normalized, must_target_committed_or_task_authorized_evidence, must_be_resolvable_to_existing_file_or_directory_when_local) is set to false in the loaded registry
registry semantics would change PCACC-002 outcome on a TASK-1030 fixture (NEG-002 or NEG-003) compared to the in-module default; the load step refuses such a registry

schema_validation_plan.version_compatibility_behavior: exact_match_required_for_runtime_load; supersedes chain documented in a separate decision artifact
schema_validation_plan.error_message_requirements: include offending field path and observed value; never silent
schema_validation_plan.exit_code_behavior: 2 for any schema validation failure; 1 for runtime PCACC-002 violations on otherwise-valid registry; 0 for clean run
schema_validation_plan.machine_readable_evidence_behavior: single JSON record per failure, written to artifacts/verify/<task>/precommit-check-result.json; no markdown side-channel

regression_cases.title: TASK-1030 NEG-002 malformed_refs anchor remains fail
regression_cases.expected_future_behavior: PCACC-002 on case-002-malformed-evidence-ref fixture returns status=fail with actual_reason_code containing malformed_refs:garbage_token_not_a_known_prefix

regression_cases.title: TASK-1030 NEG-003 evidence_refs_section_empty anchor remains fail or explicit skip
regression_cases.expected_future_behavior: PCACC-002 on case-003-missing-evidence-ref fixture returns status=fail with actual_reason_code=evidence_refs_section_empty when context is required; or returns skipped_with_reason_code with explicit reason_code when ORC-1..ORC-4 applies, never silent pass

regression_cases.title: Valid local artifact ref passes
regression_cases.expected_future_behavior: ref starting with artifacts/ that resolves to an existing file returns status=pass with reason_code=evidence_refs_resolved

regression_cases.title: Absolute path fails
regression_cases.expected_future_behavior: ref starting with / or with Windows drive letter returns status=fail with reason_code containing malformed_refs

regression_cases.title: Parent traversal fails
regression_cases.expected_future_behavior: ref containing ../ returns status=fail with reason_code containing malformed_refs

regression_cases.title: Remote URL fails
regression_cases.expected_future_behavior: ref containing :// for http, https, ftp, file, ssh, git, or git+ssh returns status=fail with reason_code containing malformed_refs

regression_cases.title: Shell command token fails
regression_cases.expected_future_behavior: ref containing shell metacharacters such as ; | && $( ` returns status=fail with reason_code containing malformed_refs

regression_cases.title: Wildcard-only ref fails
regression_cases.expected_future_behavior: ref consisting solely of * or ** or globs returns status=fail with reason_code containing malformed_refs

regression_cases.title: Missing optional ref with reason_code is skipped_with_reason_code
regression_cases.expected_future_behavior: verify artifact under ORC-1..ORC-4 with empty Evidence Refs section returns status=skipped_with_reason_code with explicit reason_code such as evidence_refs_optional_per_orc_<id>

regression_cases.title: Missing optional ref without reason_code fails
regression_cases.expected_future_behavior: verify artifact with empty Evidence Refs section but no ORC reason_code returns status=fail with reason_code=evidence_refs_section_empty

regression_cases.title: Registry load failure fails closed with exit code 2 when explicitly requested
regression_cases.expected_future_behavior: PCACC runner invoked with --evidence-ref-policy pointing at missing/malformed/schema-mismatched registry exits with code 2 and writes machine-readable failure record; default behavior unchanged when no flag is supplied

this plan does not generate SRS, RTM, design spec, threat model, release note, migration note, user guide, or operation runbook content; section coverage is intentionally narrow and bound to the Evidence Ref policy domain.
